hero.title: A Brazilian virtual number for SMS verification
intro: In Brazil, WhatsApp isn't one messenger among many — it's how the country communicates. Shops take orders on it, doctors confirm appointments on it, and “me chama no zap” is a national phrase. An account meant for the Brazilian market starts with what everything else there starts with: a +55 number.

SMS Code gives you a real Brazilian mobile number in one tap. Use it at the verification step, and the SMS — with a code from WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Uber or Facebook — appears in the app usually within seconds.

whyCountry.title: Why choose a Brazilian number?
body: Brazil is one of the world's most engaged social-media markets: Brazilians are famously heavy users of Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, and Uber counts Brazil among its biggest countries. Services there are thoroughly used to +55 registrations — a Brazilian number slides into their flows without friction.

Brazilian mobile numbers carry a distinctive signature: after +55 and a two-digit city code comes a leading 9, marking the number as mobile, then eight more digits. Sign-up forms across Latin America recognize this shape instantly, so validation is never the part that slows you down.

tips.title: The leading 9 is the mobile marker
tips.body: Every Brazilian mobile number has a 9 right after the area code — it's how the numbering plan separates mobiles from landlines. Numbers from SMS Code follow this format, so services accept them as ordinary Brazilian mobiles.

tips.title: WhatsApp first, everything else after
tips.body: For the Brazilian market, WhatsApp is the account that matters most — commerce, support and social life all route through it. Verify it with your +55 number first, then build out Instagram, TikTok and the rest around it.

tips.title: A stuck code isn't a lost payment
tips.body: If a service keeps you waiting past the activation window, cancel the activation — the coins come back when the SMS never comes — and try again with a different Brazilian number.

faqs.q: Is it a real Brazilian mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes — a carrier-network number in the standard +55 format with the mobile 9 in place. The service you're verifying sees a normal Brazilian cell number, indistinguishable from any local subscriber's.

faqs.q: Which services fit a +55 number best?
faqs.a: WhatsApp is the obvious first pick — it's the default channel of Brazilian life — followed by Instagram, TikTok, Uber and Facebook, all of which have massive Brazilian audiences.

faqs.q: Can I use a Brazilian number from another country?
faqs.a: Yes. The number lives in the SMS Code app, so it works the same whether you're in São Paulo or nowhere near it — the code reaches you wherever you are.

faqs.q: Why does the number have an extra digit compared to older Brazilian numbers?
faqs.a: Brazil added a ninth digit — the leading 9 — to all mobile numbers years ago to expand capacity. Modern services expect it; a +55 mobile without it would be the odd one out.

faqs.q: What should I do with the account once it's verified?
faqs.a: The number rental covers the activation window, so make the account self-sufficient: add a recovery email and switch on authenticator-app 2FA right after signing up.
